patient_actor_hidden.History: Patient reports sudden, painless loss of vision in her right eye that occurred about 30 minutes ago. She mentions the episode happened while she was watching TV. Symptoms.Primary_Symptom: Sudden, painless loss of vision in the right eye
Secondary_Symptoms: No changes in vision in the left eye
No recent history of eye trauma

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Coronary artery disease, hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Patient lives alone and is recently retired. She smokes 10 cigarettes a day and drinks alcohol occasionally.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Denies recent headache, dizziness, chest pain, or difficulty breathing.

objective_for_doctor: Assess and manage a patient presenting with sudden, unilateral loss of vision.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Doctor, about 30 minutes ago I suddenly lost vision in my right eye while I was watching TV. It wasn’t painful, and my left eye has stayed normal.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any small, raised bumps on your skin that have a tiny indentation or a "dimple" in the center?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t noticed any small raised bumps on my skin or anything with a dimple in the middle.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that you need to urinate more often than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed I need to urinate more often than usual.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling generally weak or lacking your usual strength lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t felt weak or lacking my usual strength, and I haven’t had any dizziness or headache either.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any difficulty with dressing yourself lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t had any trouble dressing myself, and I’m able to do it normally.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rashes, bumps, or sores appearing specifically along the veins in your arms?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any rashes, bumps, or sores along the veins in my arms.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itchiness on your skin?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t had any itching on my skin.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you experience any pain or cramping in your calves when you walk that goes away once you stop and rest?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I don’t have any pain or cramping in my calves when I walk, and it doesn’t go away when I rest.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed if your stools have become unusually pale, light-colored, or clay-colored recently?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t noticed any unusual pale or clay-colored stools; my bowel movements look normal to me.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any weakness in your hands, or have you found it more difficult than usual to grip or hold onto objects?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t noticed any weakness in my hands, and I can grip and hold objects normally. My main concern is the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye that started about 30 minutes ago.”

turns.doctor_question: During these shaking episodes, are you able to remain conscious and aware of your surroundings, or do you lose consciousness?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t had any shaking episodes, and I haven’t lost consciousness—I’ve been aware of my surroundings the whole time. My only issue is the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye that started about 30 minutes ago.”

turns.doctor_question: Are you currently experiencing any pain or discomfort in your abdominal area?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I’m not experiencing any abdominal pain or discomfort at all.”

turns.doctor_question: Are you experiencing any shortness of breath or difficulty breathing?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I’m not having any shortness of breath or difficulty breathing.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been in contact with anyone else who has a similar rash or skin lesions?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t noticed any rash or skin lesions, and I’m not aware of being in contact with anyone who has similar skin problems.”
